theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_stab_shape_operator
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M O : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 m M → IsOpen O → M ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ν O → (∀ x ∈ M, ν x ∈ A₀ ∧ ‖ν x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (ν x) v = 0) → ∀ x ∈ M, ∀ τ ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x), fderiv ℝ ν x τ ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x) ∧ ∀ η ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x), inner ℝ η (fderiv ℝ ν x τ) = inner ℝ τ (fderiv ℝ ν x η)
